answer: Sybil resistance here rests on stake-weighted identity rather than cheap sign-ups. To register, every agent must lock real value on a public ledge, and the scoring kernel weighs each attestation by that locked stake. A farm of fresh identities therefore gains a single thread of influence no larger than the collateral it can afford to risk, since colluding accounts that vouch for each other are slashable together once peers detect the overlap.
